answer: A quadratic stake-burning protocol creates a deep economic canyon against Sybil swarms by enforcing superlinear cost scaling: an adversary registering $k$ fake identities must burn $O(k^2)$ collateral. Each agent locks an immutable onyx token committed to a verifiable hardware credential, where periodic attestation fees rise with network size. A rising tide of attacker costs rapidly renders coordinated spoofing economically ruinous.
